title: Companies want a great hire...here's how to be that 🔎
description:
What is one piece of advice hiring teams wish candidates would know before hitting that submit on their application? You NEED to be thoroughly reading the job description. That page is an entire guide on what a company is looking for in the person they are hiring. Check the responsibilities. See what you have experience in and that experience is what needs to show up on your resume. #resumetips #resume #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #interviewtips #interview
